tools.name: riven_comms_list_teams
tools.description: List sovereign Riven Comms (0.0.1) team workspaces across the tenant estate (replaces Slack workspaces and Microsoft Teams orgs).

tools.name: riven_comms_list_channels
tools.description: List channels in a Riven Comms team workspace (e.g. riven, t-rivenai, pes-supply, t-big-sky-dynamics). Use instead of Slack or Microsoft Teams channel listing.

tools.name: riven_comms_read_channel
tools.description: Read recent messages from a Riven Comms channel (e.g. town-square, announcements, agents, alerts).

tools.name: riven_comms_search_messages
tools.description: Search posts and threads inside a Riven Comms workspace.

tools.name: riven_comms_post_message
tools.description: Post a message, rollout summary, or reply thread to a Riven Comms channel (https://rivenai.io/comms). Replaces Slack and Microsoft Teams channel posting.

tools.name: riven_scm_list_projects
tools.description: List repositories in Riven SCM (scm.rivenai.io). Replaces GitHub repository listing for sovereign Riven repositories.

tools.name: riven_scm_list_merge_requests
tools.description: List merge requests in Riven SCM (scm.rivenai.io). Replaces GitHub pull request listing for Riven projects.

tools.name: riven_scm_list_pipelines
tools.description: List recent CI/CD pipelines for a Riven SCM project.

tools.name: riven_erp_status
tools.description: Check live Riven ERP (0.0.06+e) JSON-RPC endpoint and version metadata.

tools.name: riven_control_list_models
tools.description: List active models and routing modes served by Riven Control.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: riven_comms_read_channel, riven_comms_search_messages, riven_scm_list_merge_requests · Public sink: riven_comms_post_message.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: riven_comms_read_channel, riven_comms_search_messages, riven_scm_list_merge_requests · Public sink: riven_comms_post_message

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
